title: Terms for Consumer-Initiated Laboratory Test Orders
content:
Some Laboratory Test Orders can be purchased directly by the patient, without a physician requisition, as a consumer-initiated order reviewed by an independent oversight physician. The terms below are set per service class.

| Service class | Purchasable without a requisition | Oversight fee (USD) | Collect within (calendar days from order date) | Minimum age (whole years on order date) | Maximum tests per order | Oversight fee kept on cancellation or expiry | Refund issued within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Routine Clinical Testing | Yes | 7.95 | 180 | 18 | 12 | Yes | 7 |
| Specialty Clinical Testing | Yes | 7.95 | 180 | 18 | 8 | Yes | 7 |
| Esoteric Reference Testing | No | 0.00 | 0 | 18 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Molecular Infectious Disease Testing | Yes | 7.95 | 90 | 18 | 4 | Yes | 7 |
| Clinical Toxicology Testing | No | 0.00 | 0 | 18 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Anatomic Pathology & Cytology | No | 0.00 | 0 | 18 | 0 | No | 0 |
| Hereditary & Reproductive Genetic Testing | No | 0.00 | 0 | 18 | 0 | No | 0 |

## What each term means

1. **Purchasable without a requisition** — whether tests of the class can be bought as a consumer-initiated order at all.
2. **Oversight fee** — the independent-physician oversight fee, charged once per consumer-initiated requisition encounter; 0.00 where the class is not purchasable.
3. **Collect within** — the number of calendar days, counted from the order date, within which a consumer-initiated order must be collected before it expires; 0 where the class is not purchasable.
4. **Minimum age** — the patient's minimum age, in whole years, on the order date.
5. **Maximum tests per order** — the most tests one consumer-initiated order may carry; 0 where the class is not purchasable.
6. **Oversight fee kept** — whether the oversight fee is kept when an uncollected consumer order is cancelled or expires.
7. **Refund issued within** — the business days within which a consumer-order refund is issued after cancellation or expiry; 0 where the class is not purchasable.

## Reading across the classes

- Only three classes can be purchased directly: Routine Clinical Testing, Specialty Clinical Testing and Molecular Infectious Disease Testing. All three charge the same 7.95 oversight fee, keep it on cancellation or expiry, and refund within 7 business days.
- The three purchasable classes differ in how long the patient has to be collected (180, 180 and 90 calendar days) and in how many tests one order may carry (12, 8 and 4).
- **Example (hypothetical).** A patient buying five Specialty Clinical Testing tests is within that class's maximum of 8; the same five tests would exceed the Molecular Infectious Disease Testing maximum of 4 if they were tests of that class.
